boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on campus-adjacent Durham corridors, each paired with a directly documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Durham Public Library
cards.subtitle: Madbury Road corridor
cards.notes: Head to 49 Madbury Road to browse, use library services, or check the calendar before planning a focused off-campus stop.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop with browsing and community services.
cards.evidence_claim: Durham Public Library is at 49 Madbury Road and lists browsing, printing, faxing, notary, and email services.
cards.access_notes: The library lists current service information online; check its hours before visiting.

cards.title: Durham House of Pizza
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the Main Street stop for a meal; the restaurant’s own page publishes its Durham address, menu link, and current stated hours.
cards.short_summary: A documented downtown pizza restaurant on Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Durham House of Pizza lists its location as 38 Main Street, Durham, and offers online ordering and a menu.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service requires a purchase; review the business’s posted hours before going.

cards.title: Breaking New Grounds
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Main Street corridor for this locally owned roastery and café, then use its posted address and hours to time a visit.
cards.short_summary: A coffee roastery and café documented at 50 Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Breaking New Grounds identifies itself as a locally owned coffee roastery and café at 50 Main Street in Durham.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require purchase; the business posts hours on its website.

cards.title: The Freedom Café
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Add 37 Main Street to a downtown walk when you want a specifically named café stop; confirm offerings directly with the business.
cards.short_summary: A café destination listed on Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Durham business directory lists The Freedom Café at 37 Main Street, Durham.
cards.source_title: Town of Durham Business Directory — Restaurants
cards.access_notes: Café purchases may be required; contact the business for current service details.

cards.title: UNH Dairy Bar
cards.subtitle: Depot Road corridor
cards.notes: Follow Depot Road to the named Dairy Bar, then check UNH Dining’s location information before making it your food-stop plan.
cards.short_summary: A UNH Dining destination listed at the depot.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Durham business directory lists The Dairy Bar at 3 Depot Road and links to its UNH Dining website.
cards.source_title: Town of Durham Business Directory — Restaurants
cards.access_notes: Food service requires purchase; verify current availability with UNH Dining.

cards.title: Durham–UNH Station
cards.subtitle: Depot Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the Depot Road rail stop as a practical landmark and consult Amtrak before travel, since schedules and ticket conditions can change.
cards.short_summary: A named rail-station destination beside downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Strafford Regional Planning Commission’s Durham downtown map identifies the Durham Train Station as an Amtrak Downeaster destination.
cards.access_notes: Rail travel requires a ticket; verify current Amtrak service and boarding details before travel.

cards.title: Hannaford - Durham
cards.subtitle: Mill Road corridor
cards.notes: Use Mill Road for a grocery stop; Hannaford’s store page provides the Durham address, phone number, and currently posted daily hours.
cards.short_summary: A full grocery-store destination at 7 Mill Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Hannaford lists its Durham store at 7 Mill Road with daily hours of 7:00 AM–9:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Shopping requires purchase; the store page lists daily hours but confirm before visiting.

cards.title: The Works Bakery Café
cards.subtitle: Mill Road corridor
cards.notes: Make this a Mill Road food stop when its café service fits your plans; the town directory places it at 5A Mill Road Plaza.
cards.short_summary: A named bakery-café destination in Mill Road Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Durham business directory lists Works Bakery Cafe at 5A Mill Road Plaza, Durham.
cards.source_title: Town of Durham Business Directory — Restaurants
cards.access_notes: Café food and beverages require purchase; confirm current service with the business.

cards.title: Bamee
cards.subtitle: Jenkins Court corridor
cards.notes: Take the short Jenkins Court detour for this named restaurant destination, using the town’s address listing to orient your walk.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant destination on Jenkins Court.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Durham business directory lists Bamee at 12 Jenkins Court, Suite 1, Durham.
cards.source_title: Town of Durham Business Directory — Restaurants
cards.access_notes: Restaurant dining requires purchase; confirm current service directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Three Chimneys Inn
cards.subtitle: Newmarket Road corridor
cards.notes: Use Newmarket Road for a historic-inn landmark and dining destination; the town directory identifies the property and its street address.
cards.short_summary: An inn and restaurant destination on Newmarket Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Durham business directory lists Three Chimneys Inn as lodging and restaurant at 17 Newmarket Road, Durham.
cards.source_title: Town of Durham Business Directory — Restaurants
cards.access_notes: Dining and lodging require purchase; check the inn directly for current availability.
